planets.name: TIC 46432937 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TIC 46432937 with a 1.44-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TIC 46432937 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TIC 46432937. Its orbit and size follow Hartman et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
